selection: one disjoint NAICS cut across aggregation levels 74, 75 and 76; never add its parent sector controls to selected rows
ownership_semantics: ownership is a separate source axis; public hospitals, utilities and transportation retain their technical functions

functions.label: Food
functions.qualification: Agriculture, fishing and food/beverage proxy; includes non-food crops and mixed agricultural support.

functions.label: Extraction
functions.qualification: Forestry and mining proxy; no physical resource stocks or extraction yields observed.

functions.label: Energy/utilities
functions.qualification: Utilities and petroleum/coal products proxy; electricity, fuel and water outputs remain distinct runtime quantities.

functions.label: Manufacturing
functions.qualification: Mixed intermediate, consumer and capital uses; this is not an observed consumption-goods department.

functions.label: Capital goods
functions.qualification: Designed machinery/electronics/equipment/transport proxy includes consumer vehicles, appliances and electronics. Other sectors also produce capital goods; QCEW does not observe product end-use.

functions.label: Construction/housing
functions.qualification: Construction and real-estate employment do not measure housing stock, dwellings or completed construction.

functions.label: Distribution/transport
functions.qualification: Wholesale, retail and transportation/storage remain distinct source cells; no freight tonnage or route capacity is inferred.

functions.label: Household services
functions.qualification: Education, health, recreation, accommodation/food services and other services are a broad service proxy, not measured household consumption.

functions.label: Business services
functions.qualification: Information, finance, rental, professional and support activities have mixed final uses; no productive/unproductive class judgment is encoded.

functions.label: Public provisioning
functions.qualification: Public administration is a technical function, not all publicly owned activity. Public budgets can fund other functions without counting those jobs again.

unsupported_needs: physical output, commodity composition and input recipes
product end-use: capital, intermediate and consumer allocation
named employers, workplaces and ownership chains
distinct persons, resident workforce, commuting and worker allocation
unpaid household work, informal activity and self-employment outside QCEW coverage
inventories, equipment, natural resource stocks and usable capacities
service quantity units, access, demand and capacity
prices, bank balances, payments, profits and funding decisions
within-county placement and domestic unallocated xx999 job placement
runtime_authority: source evidence and Designed classification only; runtime recipes, allocation and approximations require separate captured provenance
